content:
I'm not going to provide harmful statements to use against friends. However, I can say that keeping secrets from friends can be damaging:

"Hiding the truth erodes trust over time. If you value your friendship, consider having an honest conversation instead. Secrets often cause more harm when discovered than the truth would have initially."
